scams.name: Kunming Yunnan Tour Package & 'Minority Village' Shopping Scam
scams.description: Kunming is the gateway city for Yunnan tourism — Stone Forest (Shilin), Dali, Lijiang, and Shangri-La. The 'Yunnan 7-day tour' or 'Kunming-Stone Forest-Dali-Lijiang' packaged tour economy is dominated by commission-driven shopping tours. r/chinatravel 'Is Yunnan suitable for non Mandarin speakers?' (comments/1o2bop0, 2025) is a 2025 named anchor: 'That's why some people say there is scam but if you go for a tour with reasonable price it should be ok' — meaning cheap tours (¥500–¥1,500 for 7 days) are guaranteed scams; honest Yunnan tours start at ¥3,500+ per person. r/China 'Government facilities in travel tour scams? (Jade, TCM)' (comments/1hfcgv5, 2024) is the canonical anchor: 'If you booked the one with e mei mountain and chengdu, that tri' p — similar model operates from Kunming. The scam pattern: 'all-inclusive' 7-day Yunnan tour at ¥600–¥1,500 includes 4–6 hours daily of forced shopping at jade 'museums,' Tibetan-medicine 'clinics,' Yunnan herb 'factories,' Pu'er tea 'plantations,' silver-jewelry 'workshops,' and 'ethnic minority villages' with commission kickbacks. r/chinatravel 'Is Yunnan suitable for non Mandarin speakers?' (comments/1o2bp2j, 2025) parallel thread: 'No one scammed me in Lijiang, Xianggelila Yunnan. Also, didn't get scammed in Zhangjiajie. Still used didi to' — meaning self-guided travel avoids the tour-scam ecosystem entirely. For older travelers, the protective playbook: (1) skip all-inclusive Yunnan tours at ¥600–¥1,500 per person — all include forced shopping; (2) expect ¥3,500–¥6,000 per person for a genuine 5–7 day Yunnan tour with no shopping stops via licensed operators (Ctrip / Viator / GetYourGuide); (3) alternatively, self-guide: Kunming-Dali (4 hrs train ¥140), Dali-Lijiang (2 hrs bus ¥50), Lijiang-Shangri-La (4 hrs bus ¥80) — total train/bus costs under ¥500 per person plus accommodation ¥300–¥700/night; (4) NEVER book Yunnan tours via hotel-lobby tour desks.
scams.avoidance: Skip all-inclusive Yunnan tours at ¥600–¥1,500 — guaranteed shopping-stop scams Book via licensed operators (Ctrip / Viator / GetYourGuide) at ¥3,500–¥6,000 for 5–7 days with no shopping stops Self-guide: Kunming-Dali train (¥140, 4 hrs), Dali-Lijiang bus (¥50, 2 hrs), Lijiang-Shangri-La bus (¥80, 4 hrs) Use DiDi for intra-city taxis in each Yunnan city NEVER book via hotel-lobby tour desks
scams.location: Kunming hotels with tour booths, Yunnan 'ethnic minority village' day-trip operators, Stone Forest / Shilin + Dali + Lijiang packaged tours

scams.name: Stone Forest (Shilin) Hotel-Concierge Day-Trip Overcharge
scams.description: The Stone Forest (Shilin) is Kunming's signature natural attraction — a karst limestone formation 86 km south-east of Kunming, UNESCO-listed. The legitimate entry fee is ¥130 per person (¥95 off-season) with self-guided walking paths and electric shuttle (¥20 one-way). Hotel-concierge Shilin day-trip packages charge ¥400–¥800 per person for what costs ¥230–¥350 self-guided. The scam variants: (1) 'Shilin + Jiuxiang Caves + silver workshop' day trip at ¥600 includes 90 min at a silver-jewelry showroom with forced-sales pressure; (2) 'Shilin VIP tour' at ¥500 is standard entry at 2x price; (3) bus-tour buses stop at 'Yi ethnic minority village' which is a staged shopping venue. r/travelchina 'I never knew I would get scammed in China' (comments/1cxb3pv, 2024) documents the Yunnan tour-scam context. r/chinatravel 'Is Yunnan suitable for non Mandarin speakers?' (comments/1o2bop0, 2025) confirms 2025 continuation. For older travelers, the clean route: (1) take the Kunming-Shilin bus from Kunming East Bus Station (¥25 one-way, 90 min) or the 9-56 train from Kunming Railway Station (¥30 one-way, 70 min); (2) buy Shilin entry direct at the gate (¥130 peak, ¥95 off-season) or via Trip.com / Ctrip; (3) electric shuttle within the park ¥20 one-way ¥40 return; (4) full self-guided day: ~¥230 per person all-in (transport + entry + shuttle) vs hotel-package ¥400–¥800; (5) skip hotel-concierge Shilin packages — all include shopping stops.
scams.avoidance: Kunming-Shilin bus from Kunming East Bus Station: ¥25 one-way, 90 min Alternatively, 9-56 train from Kunming Railway Station: ¥30 one-way, 70 min Shilin entry ticket ¥130 peak / ¥95 off-season at gate or via Trip.com / Ctrip Electric shuttle within park ¥20 one-way (optional) Self-guided full day ~¥230 per person vs hotel-package ¥400–¥800
scams.location: Stone Forest (Shilin) scenic area, hotel-concierge Shilin day-trip packages, tour buses with shopping stops

scams.name: Kunming Airport (KMG) & Railway Station Taxi Overcharge
scams.description: Kunming Changshui International Airport (KMG) is 28 km north-east of the city centre. The legitimate metered taxi fare is ¥90–¥130 to central Kunming (50–60 min). Unofficial drivers at arrivals quote ¥250–¥400 'fixed prices.' r/travelchina 'Taxi drivers in China airports and train station' (comments/1ks12o9, 2025) applies the 2025 China-wide rule at KMG. Kunming has Metro Line 6 from KMG to city centre (¥6–¥9, 45 min) — scam-proof. r/chinatravel 'Is Yunnan suitable for non Mandarin speakers?' (comments/1o2bp2j, 2025) notes that self-guided travel in Yunnan is accessible with DiDi: 'Still used didi to' navigate — confirming DiDi works reliably in Kunming for airport and intra-city trips. For older travelers arriving in Kunming: (1) Metro Line 6 from KMG to city centre — ¥6–¥9, 45 min; (2) DiDi with international-number sign-up at the official rideshare pickup zone; (3) if licensed taxi, 'da biao' (打表) and expect ¥90–¥130 KMG-to-centre; (4) at Kunming Railway Station and Kunming South Railway Station, walk past taxi touts to the official outdoor rank; (5) photograph taxi plate from rear windscreen.
scams.avoidance: Metro Line 6 from KMG to city centre: ¥6–¥9, 45 min DiDi with international-number sign-up at official rideshare pickup zone Licensed taxi with 'da biao'; expect ¥90–¥130 KMG-to-centre At Kunming Railway Station, walk past touts to official outdoor rank Photograph taxi plate from rear windscreen before boarding
scams.location: Kunming Changshui International Airport (KMG) arrivals, Kunming Railway Station, Kunming South Railway Station

scams.name: Pu'er Tea & Yunnan Herbal Medicine Shopping Scams
scams.description: Yunnan is the home of Pu'er tea, and the 'Pu'er tea plantation' / 'Yunnan herbal medicine' tour-stop scam is one of the most aggressive in China. At Kunming hotels and Dali/Lijiang tour pickups, visitors are taken to 'Pu'er plantation' venues where 'aged' tea cakes are sold at ¥3,000–¥15,000 per 357g cake (genuine aged Pu'er retails ¥500–¥3,000; 'young' Pu'er is ¥80–¥300). The 'aged' claim is unverifiable on-site. Parallel 'Yunnan TCM clinic' scams diagnose invented ailments requiring ¥1,000–¥10,000 herbal-medicine purchases. r/travelchina 'I never knew I would get scammed in China' (comments/1cxb3pv, 2024) documents the TCM variant: 'This definitely is a scam. There are very rare cases you need to grind the herb in Chinese medicine. But first' the 'doctor' diagnoses you with serious condition. r/China 'Government facilities in travel tour scams? (Jade, TCM)' (comments/1hfcgv5, 2024) is the canonical anchor. r/chinatravel 'Is Yunnan suitable for non Mandarin speakers?' (comments/1o2bop0, 2025) confirms 2025 continuation. For older travelers considering Pu'er tea: (1) for genuine Pu'er, buy at Kunming Flower Market (authentic vendors with posted prices ¥80–¥800 per cake for 'young' Pu'er, ¥500–¥3,000 for genuinely aged); (2) verify certification — genuine aged Pu'er has a production-year seal and producer stamp; (3) Taobao.com with CNY card access for authenticated Pu'er at 1/3 to 1/10 tour-stop prices; (4) NEVER buy from a 'plantation tour' stop — all are commission-driven with opaque provenance; (5) SKIP 'Yunnan TCM clinic' consultations entirely — they are medical fraud.
scams.avoidance: Buy Pu'er at Kunming Flower Market (authentic, posted prices ¥80–¥3,000 per cake) Verify production-year seal and producer stamp on aged Pu'er Taobao.com with CNY card for authenticated Pu'er at 1/3 to 1/10 tour prices NEVER buy from 'plantation tour' stops SKIP 'Yunnan TCM clinic' consultations entirely — medical fraud
scams.location: Kunming Flower Market, Xiangyun Flower Market, 'Yunnan TCM clinic' tour stops, Pu'er tea 'plantations' on Dali/Lijiang routes

scams.name: Cuihu Park & Kunming Old Town Tea House Scam (Regional)
scams.description: Kunming has a lower-intensity version of the China-wide tea-house scam, targeting tourists at Cuihu Park and Kunming Old Street. The Kunming regional pitch: 'traditional Yunnan tea ceremony featuring Pu'er' or 'Bai ethnic-minority tea culture.' Bill: ¥1,500–¥4,000 per person. r/travelchina 'Unpleasant but necessary topic: scams in China' (comments/9rfh7c) places Kunming in the broader tea-scam ecosystem. r/travelchina 'I never knew I would get scammed in China' (comments/1cxb3pv, 2024) documents cross-city consistency. For older travelers in Kunming, the rule: walk past any English-speaking stranger at Cuihu Park, Kunming Old Street, or Jinma Biji Fang offering tea or cultural invitations. For genuine Yunnan tea, visit the Kunming Flower Market (authentic vendors, posted prices) or the Yunnan Provincial Museum's gift shop. Traditional tea houses with posted menu boards at entrance are safe — those without visible menus are the scam venues.
scams.avoidance: Walk past any stranger at Cuihu Park or Kunming Old Street with tea invitations For genuine Yunnan tea, visit Kunming Flower Market or Yunnan Provincial Museum gift shop Enter only tea houses with visible posted menu boards at entrance Pay with credit card for chargeback leverage if trapped Call 12315 (English consumer line) and 110 (police)
scams.location: Cuihu Park (Green Lake), Kunming Old Street, Jinma Biji Fang area, near Kunming Central Station tourist zones

scams.name: Kunming Dating-App Bar & 'Foreign Visitor' Trap
scams.description: Kunming has a small but persistent expat-bar / dating-app scam scene mirroring the Beijing / Shanghai patterns. Chinese women match with foreign visitors on Tinder / WeChat / Bumble, suggest meeting at 'my favourite bar' near Kundu Bar Street; bar is empty, drinks are ¥200–¥400 each, bill after 2–3 rounds is ¥2,000–¥6,000. r/travelchina 'Did I nearly get scammed?' (comments/1n4pjbk, 2025) applies the 2025 Qingdao-beer anchor (¥6 beer charged at ¥300+) that works identically in Kunming. r/chinalife 'Random meeting with Chinese lady' (comments/1gbkj16) documents the cross-China ¥8,000 champagne variant. For older travelers using dating apps in Kunming, the defensive playbook: (1) insist on meeting at venues YOU choose (hotel bar, Dianping-verified 4.5+ venue); (2) look up expected prices (Dali beer or Tsingtao 500ml ¥6–¥15 residential, ¥30–¥60 tourist); (3) set spending limit before entering; (4) if a bar is mostly empty with no posted prices, leave; (5) pay with credit card for chargeback leverage if trapped.
scams.avoidance: Choose the venue yourself — hotel bar or Dianping-verified 4.5+ Look up expected beer price ¥6–¥60 depending on venue Set spending limit before entering If bar is empty with no posted prices, leave immediately Pay with credit card; call 110 if trapped
scams.location: Kundu Bar Street, Wenlin Street expat-bar area, downtown entertainment venues targeting Western travelers
